attributes.context: The chunk defines Online Courses as primarily online, with no direct onsite contact or a maximum of three hours, scheduled instructor availability, no office hours, and a maximum required enrollment of 25; it also states that Correspondence Study and Provisional Telecourses do not require an online component.

extraction_text: If it becomes necessary for a full-time or part-time priority-hiring-list faculty member to teach an Online Course in order to meet a full-time load requirement or a part-time priority-hiring-list assignment, the District will provide professional development in conducting Online Courses on the first assignment of such a course.

attributes.context: The chunk lists course categories—Correspondence Study, Provisional Telecourse, Regular Telecourse, Online Course, and Interactive Electronic Course—and states that distance learning courses are subject to the same curriculum review as regular classes and may be subject to additional reviews as distance learning criteria are developed.

extraction_text: Adaptation of a course from one category to another (e.g., from Correspondence to Online or from classroom-based to distance modes) should be undertaken only after agreement for such development has been made with the appropriate administrators.
